title: 49ers All-Pro Nick Bosa dealing with tendinitis in surgically repaired right knee; Christian McCaffrey misses another practice

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 49ers All-Pro Nick Bosa dealing with tendinitis in surgically repaired right knee; Christian McCaffrey misses another practice
sources.description: There was good news from 49ers camp Tuesday. Mike Evans was back at practice. Kyle Shanahan, meanwhile, downplayed Bosa's tendinitis as "normal."
